records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: host:claude -p --no-session-persistence --tools '' --include-hook-events --output-format stream-json ran twice with PATH=~/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, so the hook and the installed add-module could only use the macOS system python3 3.9.6
result:both session inits loaded spec-guard 0.29.0 from the plugin cache and UserPromptSubmit exited 0 each time
result:in a temporary consumer repository whose current module infra was half done, the hook injected BUILDING for infra
result:the installed add-module accepted the interrupt and wrote only the capability map; the next session's hook injected NEEDS_SPEC for urgent with the line Paused: infra (1 unchecked item(s))

limit:the resume-after-interrupt MODULE_DONE hint and the module-interrupt mainline boundary were not exercised on the host; test-phase-guard.sh, test_module_insert.py and test_proposal_mainline_review.py cover them
